name: P1 (To make it easier, you can begin with the Quick...)
text: To make it easier, you can begin with the Quick start section, then learn one of the inductions and the whole return sequence. Then, you can read the “Let the next response guide you” section, for the part of the practice no recording can decide in advance. Also read some of the stuff in the daily and weekly sections, to make the practice your own. There are lots of appendices with extra tools, covering lots of topics, including asking questions, NLP patterns of language, working with anxiety, working with daydreams, altered states in general, what to do if you experience the sensation of a hostile presence, working with sleep, influence, and more inductions. All sources used are in Appendix K.

name: P2 (Have you ever realized that you were born with a...)
text: Have you ever realized that you were born with an incredible brain/mind that has many layers of consciousness and can dream, protect, analyze, imitate, love, remember, hide, show, heal, etc, etc?

name: P3 (“How do I do this?” you ask. Just listen silentl...)
text: “How do I do this?” you ask. Just listen silently. Many people skip the listening or shorten it since it’s not “achieving something” but this is by far the most important step. When you warm up to what’s there, protect it, clarify what it is, reality test it, and then act on it, you’ll find that you don’t even need to have a dramatic trance experience to demonstrate the results of all parts of your mind talking to each other and trusting each other more.

name: P4 (I work with the subconscious as if it were an ec...)
text: I work with the subconscious as if it were an ecology, and often begin hypnosis working with the Higher Self (universal heart) and only separate into parts when needed. I combine this with inner child reparenting (a clever suggestion won’t heal a hurt young part), and also aspects of prompt engineering (the shape of a question changes the kind of answer we can hear), as well as influence literacy, since hypnosis is hardly the only thing hypnotizing us.
why: 22 new words, 13 of them in a row from his published version

name: P5 (To work on difficulties or cultivate positive qu...)
text: To work on difficulties or cultivate positive qualities (love, curiosity, play, confidence, etc.), simply do these steps, in order: 1) Gather attention; 2) Notice what is here; 3) Offer one fitting response; 4) Wait; 5) Come all the way back. Not much needs to happen in each session!

name: P6 (Prior to your first session, read through the in...)
text: Prior to your first session, read through the induction and the full return in waking life, so you’re more familiar with them. Give yourself a chunk of time when you can be physically secure for the time it takes. Then put the screen aside; the practice is something you learn to conduct, not a checklist to keep reading.
why: 15 new words, 12 of them in a row from his published version

name: P7 (You’ll follow whatever you notice - sensation, i...)
text: You’ll follow whatever you notice - sensation, image, phrase, feeling, objection, silence - as you’re invited. Vary the invites as needed to be responsive & warm, to create a boundary, to give direction or more time, etc. Complete the return to normal waking consciousness. After, note what happened & any real-world actions.

name: P8 (If at any point you feel panicky, disoriented, m...)
text: If at any point you feel panicky, disoriented, more unreal, or less functional, this is not the time for bravely sticking with difficult feelings (that’s another choice, made freely & while staying present). Stop deepening, return to the room & get appropriate support.

name: P9 (Keep in mind that it’s normal, even for people w...)
text: Keep in mind that it’s normal, even for people who do think in words, to sometimes notice feelings before words.

name: P10 (Even when not actively engaging the conscious mi...)
text: Even when not actively engaging the conscious mind, there are many ways to influence people. Marketers and interface designers know this perfectly well. In the Federal Trade Commission’s report on “dark patterns,” they describe designs that trick or manipulate consumers. The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) describes commercial patterns that steer, deceive, coerce, or manipulate people toward choices that may work against their interests.

name: P11 (All of these are separate factors to consider: c...)
text: All of these are separate factors to consider: conscious agreement, unconscious receptivity, emotional compliance, legal and ethical consent. People have their minds influenced without the conscious agreement of their adult self.

name: P12 (A line associated with the Silva Mind Control tr...)
text: A line associated with the Silva Mind Control tradition says it plainly:

name: P13 (With self-hypnosis you can train your own mind f...)
text: With self-hypnosis you can train your own mind from the inside, by befriending and listening to the deeper part of your mind. This opens up a whole new area of choice for you as an adult in the world.

name: P14 (DO NOT use Self Hypnosis to help you: force your...)
text: DO NOT use Self Hypnosis to help you: force yourself to remember trauma, force yourself to prove trauma through memories, suppress medical symptoms, de-stabilize your self, or replace appropriate clinical care.

name: P15 (The mind of love and the mind of analysis can BO...)
text: The mind of love and the mind of analysis can BOTH be there - warmth and brightness. The mind of intuition and the mind of rationality can BOTH be there - intuitive signals without dogma, and testing of those signals without killing them. The body can have a voice - saying yes or no or not yet. The imagination can have opened up the field and then the adult can choose what to do next in the real world…. It can be peaceful but also precise.

name: P16 (Without the mind of love the mind of analysis ca...)
text: Without the mind of love the mind of analysis can be sterile. Without the mind of analysis the mind of love can lead to fantasy. Without testing intuitive signals they can become delusions. Without intuitive signals the testing can be dead. So these modes can correct each other.

name: P17 (And it’s got to lead somewhere: kinder behavior,...)
text: And it’s got to lead somewhere: kinder behavior, more humility, better judgment, real service, or a more workable ordinary life.

I was sober at the session and didn’t feel especially suggestible, but I suspect that’s not even the main reason the pro didn’t work very well for me. The bigger issue was trust and precision.

name: P19 (When I do it on my own, I can detect when the wo...)
text: When I do it on my own, I can detect when the wording I’m using for a suggestion to my subconscious is slightly off, and talk to my subconscious to find out what it thinks is wrong with the wording. When I use an image, I can tell whether it’s giving me useful information, or just telling me what I’m afraid of, or what I want to avoid, or what I want to be true, or something I don’t understand yet. And I can notice my body saying no before my conscious mind talks me into a yes.

name: P20 (Self-hypnosis simply has one advantage nobody ou...)
text: Self-hypnosis simply has one advantage nobody outside can duplicate: immediate dialogue with the system itself. I found that especially amplified with loveyhuasca. My experiences included a much deeper understanding of my motivations, peaceful loving awareness operating alongside analytical clarity, the disappearance of unhelpful daydreaming, different priorities around relationships, stronger intuition, and repeated correction between intuition, subconscious response, and conscious analysis.

name: P21 (In the same vein, self-hypnosis seemed to extend...)
text: In the same vein, self-hypnosis seemed to extend a short chrunga trip for what felt like a long time, and it feels like if I needed to I could have continued for an arbitrary amount of time. It only ended because life needed me to talk to people, etc. Phenomenologically, this is very important. I’m not recommending that anyone prolong an altered state forever, because it’s better to integrate, etc.

name: P22 (Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in...)
text: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, and each job keeps the others in balance. It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.

name: P23 (For that starting point, I have developed a kind...)
text: For that starting point, I have developed a kind of provisional bridge that I call “borrowed adulthood.” It’s built from familiar practices like modeling and supported action, but I’m not suggesting that the whole sequence has been formally tested and proven as one treatment.

name: P24 (The adult hat is only borrowed, so you’re still...)
text: The adult hat is only borrowed, so you’re still making the choice. The longer version of this exercise can be found in my Inner Child Self-Love Reparenting Guide.

name: P25 (You don’t have to have trustworthy people in you...)
text: You don’t have to have trustworthy people in your history. Use someone you remember when that helps, or just imagine a good adult whose intention is to take good care of you. See if you can imagine what they would say/do in your situation, with your history, limitations, options, etc. If you can’t imagine a good adult, or just imagining a caring grown-up makes you feel more threatened, or lonelier, start smaller, with the least cruel response you can believe. Once you’ve found something good, try it, don’t keep doing the exercise.

name: P26 (You can choose to let the parts of you that feel...)
text: You can choose to let the parts of you that feel younger express themselves without handing over the adult part of you to the caretaker in another person or without actually going back in age. In this way, you can access all of the positive aspects of what it can be like to feel younger such as feeling wonder, silliness, approaching things through the senses more, feeling it’s ok to be vulnerable, to let someone take care of you, to feel need, and to want to offload some decision making, while your adult part stays present.

name: P27 (There is a simple and easy body technique to con...)
text: There is a simple and easy body technique to connect with your inner child. Just place one hand in the center of your chest which is physically connecting you to your love and then place your other hand just below that, on your solar plexus, where your child can be.

name: P28 (The Nurturer: Some of the work you can do as the...)
text: The Nurturer: Some of the work you can do as the Nurturer is to enjoy your inner child. You don’t have to move their feelings, just sit back and enjoy their company. Be happy that they are there. Children need to be enjoyed! Say things to your inner child like:

name: P29 (If it’s hard to bring up the warm stuff, you can...)
text: If it’s hard to bring up the warm stuff, you can always do something to protect your inner child. Make sure it’s small enough that you can actually do it. If you’re not able to, figure out what’s getting in the way of you doing it. Are you scared? Tired? Do you not know how to? Is there a practical thing that’s getting in your way? Have you set yourself up to do it in a way that’s likely to be successful? Don’t make it so that doing it successfully means you have to feel good about it, or be able to check it off a list.

name: P30 (Instead, you might feel numb, cynical, angry, hu...)
text: Instead, you might feel numb, cynical, angry, hungry, like you need to look at your phone, sexually aroused, like you need to make plans, sleepy, dissociated, or you might even think that what you’re doing is stupid. Those are not failures. Often what you’re experiencing is a very charming guard. It’s what protects you when your consciously installed parental Protector isn’t functioning, the same as when you were a child. But before you decide where it’s coming from, ask it what it’s trying to stop, or what it wants. It could also be your inner child, mad that you took so long to come back, or your inherited parent script, or something from earlier today, or a bit of each.

name: P31 ((Now talk to the guard. Tell them that it makes...)
text: (Now talk to the guard. Tell them that it makes sense that they want to protect you and that they don’t have to stop protecting you, but that you want to know what could make them trust you 1% more that you can protect yourself. If it says no, I’d listen, and if it says no to going deeper in this work or to an altered state, I’d stop there and not push past that no, even when it sounds like a prediction.)

name: P32 (One important thing to become aware of when appr...)
text: One important thing to become aware of when approaching your inner child is your inherited parent script. This is the set of rules and ways of treating yourself that you internalized as a child, mostly based on how your parent(s) treated you, and it doesn’t always sound like a voice. This is not the same as your inner adult (Nurturer, Protector, Guide) that you build up on purpose. Often this script acts as a critic or warden, telling your inner child not to cry, not to be “needy”, not to embarrass them, not to be too independent, etc. So when you begin talking to your child in a new, loving way, the script may jump in to say that what you’re doing is “fake”.

name: P33 (If you can, tell the child that you are there fo...)
text: If you can, tell the child that you are there for them and that they don’t have to explain themselves, or be healed or impress you. You only want to know what would help them feel less alone.

name: P34 (It can be anything. What does the child need? wa...)
text: It can be anything. What does the child need? warmth, to play, to be protected, to mourn, to be angry, food, rest, boundaries, better relationships, to stop fantasizing, to stop working their butt off, that you keep a promise to them today, etc. etc.

name: P35 (E. Give yourself some time to let what you did s...)
text: E. Give yourself some time to let what you did sink in- it may take some time, it may take sleep, etc.

name: P36 (When you’re reparenting, it’s okay to play with...)
text: When you’re reparenting, it’s okay to play with things that interest your younger states, whether that means touching things of different textures, drawing, exercising, roleplaying with a plushie in a different voice, etc. As long as your reality testing is good and you remember that you aren’t a child or pet or doll or whatever and that nobody owns you, it’s okay to work on getting your play ability back. A lot of the best discoveries come when you’re both just messing around. Play not only paves the way for therapy, but is a part of how successful therapy should be measured.

name: P37 (Temporary Separation. Sometimes it may be wise t...)
text: Temporary Separation. Sometimes it may be wise to remove yourself, for a time, from the people or group that you normally would get answers from. Some people come back later on different terms, and sometimes the break has to be long-term because the pattern of losing yourself with them is deeply entrenched. As you become more your own person, you learn to tell which of those apply. You want to let your quieter preferences bubble up to the surface so you can be sure you’re not just echoing your social group.

name: P38 (A good guide leaves your adult more present. The...)
text: A good guide leaves your adult more present. The more powerful the state the stronger the boundaries you will need.

name: P39 (Be aware that even when using permissive languag...)
text: Be aware that even when using permissive language, you can still take away the subject’s choice. Be aware of;

name: P40 (3) Including phrases such as whether or not you...)
text: 3) Including phrases such as whether or not you notice etc etc, so either way counts as success

name: P41 (Test: For a simple, chosen target, are you getti...)
text: Test: For a simple, chosen target, are you getting the response you want out of the suggestion already? If so, you might not need to deepen.

name: P42 (Using metaphors and imagery is entirely optional...)
text: Using metaphors and imagery is entirely optional. You can use whatever form of signal shows up (feelings, rhythms, movements, words, spatial sense, simple knowing, lack of signal, whatever) but if you’re using words, try to keep them related to whatever world you’re creating. If you’re going to count, do it in a way that makes sense in your world. And when you’re done, come back the other way. (You can borrow qualities such as warmth or steadiness, but don’t change who you are.)

name: P43 (When you’re writing the script, decide what the...)
text: When you’re writing the script, decide what the verb you’re using is, what the sensory quality is, what the short refrain is, and how you’re going to transition between ideas. Read it out loud as you’re writing it. Long, elegant sentences don’t read well when you’re being induced. It’s all just soup.

name: P44 (Get clear on what it is you want to do during th...)
text: Get clear on what it is you want to do during the induction. What do you want not to do today? How long do you want to spend on this? (You don’t have to do this on a problem. You can do it on something you want to experience more of: love, play, confidence, creativity, communion, whatever.) Make sure you’re leaving some time at the end to come back, and reflect on what you experienced.

name: P45 (Put yourself in a place where you can safely do...)
text: Put yourself in a place where you can safely do this. Don’t do this if you’re driving, in the water, operating machinery, or otherwise need to be attending to yourself or other people. If you are intoxicated, acutely confused, or not able to keep yourself safe, then get some immediate support instead of doing exploratory hypnosis. (The part below called “Already open? Contain before you deepen” can be used to help orient you if you’re already open, but don’t use it to make yourself deeper if you’re not stable.)

name: P46 (Deciding to do it: how will you coax yourself to...)
text: Deciding to do it: how will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Make it firmer, so you stay with a feeling? Something else? Preview what you are going to do: will you close your eyes? Will you come out and go back in again? What will you do at the end? If you are going to use a recording, read the script beforehand if you can. Know that you can say “stop” at any time and the induction will end. If you want to change something, say “less” if you want it to be asking for less from you, or say “quiet” and the talking will stop. You can also just open your eyes and stop, and then come all the way back anyway. You don’t need to ask any parts for permission to stop, even if a part tells you that you do.

name: P47 (If you are new to this or haven’t done it for a...)
text: If you are new to this or haven’t done it for a while, work on the coming in and coming out part first, don’t bring in the hard stuff till later. You don’t have to watch yourself all the time, but for the first few times, make sure you can change state. Let yourself make it easier and easier to do this and notice that it takes less and less of you to do it. A no will stay a no. The narrator can’t add stuff just because you don’t say anything.

name: P48 (Let your response guide you as to what to do nex...)
text: Let your response guide you as to what to do next regardless of what the script is expecting. Utilize: use what you have (a thought, sound, movement, or objection) to go to the next place, whatever it is. Learn how to notice what is there. Learn how to notice if there is no change, and that no change is not a secret success. For more on language you can use, see Appendix B, or keep reading below for information on using the tools after induction in Let the next response guide you. Either way, keep the instructions about how to stay safe and how to get out plain.

name: P49 (You can read this slowly into your recorder, you...)
text: You can read this slowly into your recorder, you can read it out loud or say it to yourself if you are good at that. Choose a sound, or a contact, or the two hands thing (above) or something to anchor yourself, and choose the thing you will say to open it up. Use the same anchor for everywhere that anchor is mentioned. Don’t read the directions, just pause between paragraphs.

name: P50 (You might notice something that holds your inter...)
text: You might notice something that holds your interest, something about the sound, or sensation, or listening or something else.

name: P51 (If being still tends to make you sleepy, or diff...)
text: If being still tends to make you sleepy, or diffuse your attention, or make you want to mentally escape, you can make the hypnosis more active. Instead of getting more relaxed with the hypnosis, try getting more alert. Keep your eyes open. Pair a small repeated hand movement with increasing clarity; stop the movement and notice what remains. Don’t escape inside yourself. Say something like,

name: P52 (“Sending my love down to my Child. If something...)
text: “Sending my love down to my Child. If something comes back up, I let it, and send my love on down again. If nothing comes back, I just keep sending mine, and listening.”

name: P53 (Fractionation means returning toward ordinary aw...)
text: Fractionation means returning toward ordinary awareness and then deciding whether to enter absorption again. Used openly, it teaches that trance has a door in both directions. At some point in time you can add this, but you must say you are doing it before doing it, so no answer can secretly mean “deeper.”

name: P54 (“As you wait, you release the responsibility of...)
text: “As you wait, you release the responsibility of making anything happen.

name: P55 (Once you have learned a useful induction and how...)
text: Once you have learned a useful induction and how to come back down at the end, you can do the following….

name: P56 (Have an unusual word, phrase, and/ or motion (op...)
text: Have an unusual word, phrase, and/ or motion (optional) that you will use to go into hypnosis again. Say the word and/ or phrase while doing the motion (if applicable). Be sure to do this when you are in hypnosis and in a good place. Don’t do this when you are in a very emotional state, child state, or thinking about something that could be considered trauma. The idea is for you to be able to pick a good state to go into, and you can decide what that is.

name: P57 (Give your cue the meaning you choose: “When I pi...)
text: Give your cue the meaning you choose: “When I pick the time and place (an appropriate time and place) and say the word and/ or phrase to begin, I can go into this state that I picked and am familiar with. I can change direction, or stop, at any point.”

name: P58 (If you want to turn this one off, simply don’t p...)
text: If you want to turn this one off, simply don’t practice it anymore. Take it out of your recordings, take it out of your apps if you’re using it in an app, and start using your regular induction. Tell yourself, when you’re awake, that you won’t be using it anymore. Just because you say that it’ll be gone doesn’t mean that it’ll be gone right away. If it’s causing you a problem, if you’re still responding to it when you don’t want to respond to it, if you’re having issues with disorientation, etc, get some help from someone who’s qualified to help you with this. If, on the other hand, you want to keep it so that you can use it to go back into trance at a later date when you do want to go into a trance, that’s fine too. For now, though, once you come out of this trance, today’s session is over.

name: P59 (Here is a generic bring-back that you can use: “...)
text: Here is a generic bring-back that you can use: “When I come out of this session, I will only bring with me that which is useful to me in my everyday life right now. Anything else I will bring with me at a later date, when I am better able to integrate it. When I come out of this session, I will be coming back to the room I am in now, and to the day in which I am participating in this session now. All the instructions to carry me deeper into this session or keep me in this state are now finished. The only intention I will take with me into my everyday life, and the only cue I will use to take me into this state at a later date, will be the ones I consciously choose, and neither of them will keep me in this state. When I come out of this session I will be me, in my body and with my adult judgment.”

name: P60 (Respond to each thing that comes up with an accu...)
text: Respond to each thing that comes up with an accurate notice and a small reasonable invitation (or action or taking more time etc). The thing might be a sensation, image, gesture, feeling, words, or anything. The notice and invitation don’t need to cover all those forms, just notice and invite what happens.

name: P61 (You can be pretty straightforward when that’s th...)
text: You can be pretty straightforward when that’s the help you chose - “Let the explanation wait a moment. What do I feel as I say that?” can be a perfectly valid thing to say to yourself, and help you focus. As long as you’re still present, and able to change if you want to, and happy to carry on, a sad feeling or tension or whatever doesn’t require an exit.

name: P62 (Is this a notice or meaning? “My stomach went ti...)
text: Is this a notice or meaning? “My stomach went tight” is a notice, “He’s a complete bastard” is a meaning, even if you didn’t think it in words. You can then go on to find out what he did, notice what it was that gave you the idea, and consider if there might be other explanations. It’s also ok to put a meaning into words now, to look at it, even if it came to you without words. Nonverbal thoughts and early thoughts aren’t necessarily any deeper, truer, or more reliable than other thoughts. Feelings are good to pay attention to, but it’s still good to consider what they mean.

name: P63 (Sometimes the invitation just isn’t right - some...)
text: Sometimes the invitation just isn’t right - sometimes it’s something you hadn’t thought of. Either way, it isn’t automatically a guard, and silence doesn’t mean a hidden process is working.

name: P64 (If there is another person involved in the situa...)
text: If there is another person involved in the situation, it may be a good idea to look at what they are doing as well. Are they able to communicate in a mature fashion? Try and be specific in your description, and be willing to alter it if you find out that it was incorrect. Just because someone is disagreeing with you or trying to set boundaries around you does not mean they are in their emotionally immature parts. You don’t need to subject yourself to something that may be dangerous before protecting yourself.

name: P65 (On the other hand, you may find that you feel gu...)
text: On the other hand, you may find that you feel guilty. Having feelings of guilt does not mean that you have done something wrong or that you have been manipulated. Have you done something that was wrong or that caused harm? If so, what can you do to fix it? On the other hand, did you give in to someone else just to keep them from being disappointed in you? What do you want to do or achieve the next time you interact with this person? Do you need them to understand what you are feeling/thinking? Do you just need to communicate information to them? Do you need to set boundaries with them? Do you need to end the interaction? You don’t have to make them understand before you can act.

name: P66 (When you start to contact the difficult thing, i...)
text: When you start to contact the difficult thing, if it feels too much, immediately start to widen your awareness to something else in the room, in your body, etc. Keep moving back and forth between the difficult thing and the easier thing. This is called pendulation, and approaching in smaller amounts is titration. Do as much or as little as you feel you can.

name: P67 (“Ok, I think that is enough for now.”...)
text: “Ok, I think that is enough for now.”

name: P68 (Feel free to go back and explore more if you wis...)
text: Feel free to go back and explore more if you wish to do so. If, at any point, you start to lose contact with the here and now, feel that things are becoming more and more unreal, or you feel that you are not able to switch to something else or stop, stop trying to explore inside of yourself and just do the entire “coming back” part. If you have trouble orienting yourself and it lasts for a prolonged period of time, please get some human help rather than trying a stronger induction.

name: P69 (If you feel an urge to move, turn, reach, push,...)
text: If you feel an urge to move, turn, reach, push, or change your body’s position, feel free to either actually do something that will not cause your body pain or discomfort, or just imagine doing what you feel you need to do, and see what happens next. You do not need to act out the urge, shake, release, etc. If you do move and you feel that you are causing yourself pain or other symptoms that you are concerned about, stop moving.

name: P70 (Allow yourself to see where a metaphor takes you...)
text: Allow yourself to see where a metaphor takes you. Ask questions like ‘if the problem had an image or story, what would it be?’ or ‘what would need to happen to make things right?’ If it feels like you need to do something to give yourself the resource that you feel you need (or to put a boundary in place, or to move away or to take some other action) then try doing that for as far as it takes to be of use to you. Remember that whatever you find out is likely to be metaphorical. It may be a good hypothesis for what you need to do but it is not a proven fact.

name: P71 (Don’t feel that you have to end the session with...)
text: Don’t feel that you have to end the session with a great revelation! When you have done as much as you want to do, it is a good idea to find out if there is anything that you need to do to make sure that you can leave things where they are for the time being. This might include thanking parts for their help, or making sure that you do something in real life (eat a good meal, put a boundary in place, get some rest, repair a relationship, keep a promise etc). Whatever it is, tell your little one, “That’s enough for today. We’re going back to the life we’re building.”

name: P72 (Note: throughout the exercise, allow your analyt...)
text: Note: throughout the exercise, allow your analytical part to make comments and/or tell you that it doesn’t like what you are doing. Just tell it that you will check things out when you come back and make any commitments etc when you are back. If it says no to going deeper, or tells you to stop doing the exercise, I’d stop there and not push past that no, even when it sounds like a prediction. You can stop whenever you want to. Remember that the images that you see can be meaningful without being actual memories of things that happened and just because you see an image, or feel a body release, that doesn’t mean that you are right about what is going on!

name: P73 (You can also try other ways of inducing yourself...)
text: You can also try other ways of inducing yourself such as becoming aware of 3 things you can see, 3 things you can hear, 3 things you can feel in your body; then 2 of each, 1 of each. Then count from 5 to 1 and begin to listen. Choose one way to induce yourself, you don’t need to try all of them! (In fact, it might be counter-productive!)

name: P74 (As you come out of the process ask yourself what...)
text: As you come out of the process ask yourself what needed warmth, what needed to be protected, what you need to do differently to be more in accord with truth and love and life. Is there something you want to explore more fully or a capacity you want to build? And most importantly, what can you carry with you as you move forward from this? If you identified something you needed to do differently, make a plan with yourself to do that thing. The more specific you can be, the more likely you are to change: “If _________ (fill in the cue for the old pattern), then I will do ________ (fill in one small action that will begin to change the pattern).” Then check back later and see how you are doing – sleeping, relating, functioning, etc., not only how impressive the session felt.

name: P75 (“Dear Wise Subconscious Mind, if there is someth...)
text: “Dear Wise Subconscious Mind, if there is something you know that my conscious self is not ready to know, please don’t break it open violently! Do what you can to make me able to know it in a way that is safe! Prepare me BEFORE you break it open! Ground me BEFORE you show me the memory! Support me BEFORE you make it intense! Give me one next action!” etc.

name: P76 (REMEMBER: Not everything in hypnotic imagery is...)
text: REMEMBER: Not everything in hypnotic imagery is literal, especially if it relates to trauma and memory. The mind makes it symbolic, squashes things together, distorts, dramatizes, pulls from cultural influences, fears etc. So, treat it like an image and get some help outside of yourself!

name: P79 (Do you have a sense of what it is that feels fak...)
text: Do you have a sense of what it is that feels fake? The words, an image, what you are expecting to get from this, a role you feel you have to play etc. It doesn’t matter that you don’t have an inner voice/image to do this, it isn’t necessarily about not having a ‘grown up’ or resisting doing the work. If it feels like you are being asked to do something you don’t want to do then correct the invitation. It could be that there is a part that is protecting you, so talk to it.

name: P80 (You could say something like ‘What are you prote...)
text: You could say something like ‘What are you protecting me from?’ or ‘Are you afraid I will lie to myself again?’ or ‘Are you afraid this will just be a performance?’ If it says yes, that one can sting, because there could be something to it. Maybe you’ve fooled yourself before, and that part remembers. “Tell me what you remember, I’m listening.” works well here.

name: P81 (Open your eyes, move around, feel something text...)
text: Open your eyes, move around, feel something textured, name 5 things that you can see, and end the deeper practice for the day.

name: P82 (What do you say to yourself in that moment? “If...)
text: What do you say to yourself in that moment? “If it’s really there, it’ll still be here after a good night’s sleep, some food, some time, and some subsequent humility, feedback, etc.”

name: P83 (You’re being too analytical. “What if you didn’t...)
text: You’re being too analytical. “What if you didn’t try to improve the practice?” Put your hand on your heart, your other hand on your solar plexus, and say, “I don’t have to do this perfectly. I’m here for a relationship with something deeper than my surface mind.” “What can you do to make this a communion, not a performance?” Maybe it’s silence, resting, or doing something. Whatever it is, just do it.

name: P84 (Maybe you had a profound opening that showed you...)
text: Maybe you had a profound opening that showed you how much more love and freedom is possible. Let that matter, but don’t demand that the child receive it on command. Invite your little one in with you. They might go numb, or call BS on that. If so, they might just need to see if you’re actually humble enough, and grateful enough for them, to listen to their rejection and be patient. Maybe when you prayed it seemed like you were being abandoned and condemned. Maybe you felt betrayed by a spiritual teacher. It may be worth exploring these, but you might not want to do more of the same practice.

name: P85 (The best thing to do, though, if you notice you’...)
text: The best thing to do, though, if you notice you’re in a checking loop, is allow the thought to be there without engaging with it and get on with what you have chosen to do. You don’t have to have a meeting with every thought that pops into your head before you start your life. You don’t have to complete a ritual before you start your life.

name: P86 (DO NOT: View your inner experiences as commands...)
text: DO NOT: View your inner experiences as commands or proof. They’re internal happenings that need to be reality tested at all times.

name: P87 (If you want to deliberately do trauma-focused re...)
text: If you want to deliberately do trauma-focused regression (going backwards in your memory or imagination to times when you were younger), or affect and somatic bridging (following associations from an emotional or somatic experience to find the origin of that experience, particularly if it was a traumatic experience you don’t know about), or if you find that you’re having substantial flashbacks or dissociative reactions, then you should do this with a trauma-informed clinician present. Make sure they’re trained in the specific method you want to do. Ask any potential clinician what they would do and how they deal with uncertainty and unexpected reactions. Note that even if you work with a person, hypnosis is not a way of knowing what did or did not happen to you.

name: P88 (Start from the basis that the subconscious, the...)
text: Start from the basis that the subconscious, the body, the sharp mind, and the guard who’s tensed up and ready for the other shoe to drop for a long time are all not your enemies. Most of them have actually been trying to help you, without ever being properly introduced.
